children.text:
Hehehee! I'm the witch who summoned you! Help me gather my potion ingredients.
I need:
...the head of a Purple Moon Mushroom...
...and the body of a Homonculus.(That's you!)
Gather the ingredients in that order and deposit them in my cauldron.
You feel yourself starting to dissolve...
You have become the potion. The potion has become you.

Have you found every last ingredient? If not, follow the platformer blocks up to the teleport block that takes you back to spawn.  If you have, push the ingredients down the chute to the left, one at a time. They will begin to stack on the ramp to the right. Once all 5 have been stacked, you should be able to climb them and double jump to reach the finish. If any of the blocks do not stack properly, they will be transported to the foot of the ramp. You can push them back into the chute until they stack successfully.
You are stand on an ethereal plane. The only thing standing between you and eternal happiness is an Ember Machine™ 2.0.
Can't find the crystal? Make sure you've checked every wall.
